name: @opencut/headless-render
description: Headless render orchestrator: loads a @opencut/project-schema Project, composites frames with @napi-rs/canvas, and muxes them with ffmpeg. No browser, no GPU compositor — valid for the MVP scope (no effects/masks); see docs/mcp-headless.md.

scripts.test: tsx test/render.test.ts && tsx test/encode.test.ts && tsx test/ticks-per-second.test.ts
